title: Abbreviate a long text

blocks.text: `substring(0, n)` needs a String of at least `n` characters, so a method that shortens text first checks whether there is anything to shorten.

Write `abbreviate(String text, int max)` in `Abbreviation`. It returns `text` unchanged when it has at most `max` characters, and otherwise its first `max - 3` characters followed by `"..."`, so the result is exactly `max` long:

items: a text of exactly `max` characters is kept: `abbreviate("Exactly8", 8)` is `"Exactly8"`;
`max` below `3` leaves no room for the dots: throw `IllegalArgumentException`.

cases.says: "Hi" and "" are kept: there is nothing to shorten.

concepts: On an empty String, length() is 0, charAt(0) throws and substring(0, 0) is "".
